related.title: Trivy：映像掃描與修復可用性分流
related.titleEn: Trivy: image findings and fix-availability triage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付UID映射圖、能力與掛載表、讀寫預期測試及rootless限制說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver UID mapping, capabilities and mounts, read/write expectation tests and rootless limitations.
related.difference: 把映像摘要、資料庫時間、套件版本、公告識別及修復狀態連在一起，避免使用漂移標籤。
related.differenceEn: Link image digest, database timestamp, package version, advisory and fix status, avoiding mutable image tags.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課權限面積以允許能力數×可寫掛載數作粗略代理；不是可量測的入侵機率。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 配置A允許12項能力及4個可寫掛載；配置B只需3項能力及2個可寫掛載。 代理量A=48、B=6，縮減(48−6)/48=87.5%。
可立即修復比例=有可用相容修復的唯一發現/需處理發現；不代表修復後零風險。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 報告有30筆去重後需處理發現，18筆有修復版本，12筆暫無；其中6筆修復仍需相容性驗證。 有版本可修復比例18/30=60%；已確認可採用的修復只有12/30=40%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A teaching privilege-surface proxy multiplies allowed capabilities by writable mounts; it is not an intrusion probability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Configuration A allows twelve capabilities and four writable mounts; B needs three capabilities and two writable mounts. The proxy falls from 48 to 6, a reduction of 87.5%.

Immediately fixable fraction counts unique actionable findings with compatible fixes; it does not imply zero residual risk. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Thirty unique actionable findings include eighteen with fixes and twelve without; six available fixes still need compatibility validation. Fix availability is 60%, but confirmed adoptable fixes are only 12/30=40%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google Cloud Audit Logs：資料存取可見性與保留量
related.titleEn: Google Cloud Audit Logs: data-access visibility and retention volume
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付UID映射圖、能力與掛載表、讀寫預期測試及rootless限制說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver UID mapping, capabilities and mounts, read/write expectation tests and rootless limitations.
related.difference: 為每個服務標明所需稽核類型、實際設定、接收端、權限與保留期限，驗證資料存取的可見性。
related.differenceEn: Record required audit types, actual settings, destination, access rights and retention for each service, validating data-access visibility.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課權限面積以允許能力數×可寫掛載數作粗略代理；不是可量測的入侵機率。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 配置A允許12項能力及4個可寫掛載；配置B只需3項能力及2個可寫掛載。 代理量A=48、B=6，縮減(48−6)/48=87.5%。
保留量=每日事件×平均位元組×天數；這是未壓縮容量估算，不是供應商費用報價。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 每日合成資料存取事件200000筆，平均600byte，保留30天。 200000×600×30=3600000000byte，即3.6GB十進位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A teaching privilege-surface proxy multiplies allowed capabilities by writable mounts; it is not an intrusion probability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Configuration A allows twelve capabilities and four writable mounts; B needs three capabilities and two writable mounts. The proxy falls from 48 to 6, a reduction of 87.5%.

Retention volume equals daily events times average bytes times days; this is uncompressed sizing, not provider pricing. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic data-access volume is 200000 events per day averaging 600 bytes, retained for thirty days. 200000×600×30=3600000000 bytes, or 3.6 decimal GB.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
